reason: r4 replaces r2's tap-window hook with the code patches of clarkekoko's "Lock-on Target MHGU Recomp" cheat and its "No Target Reticle" part, applied through Forge after exact-byte checks. A tap of the target-camera button turns the lock off or on; while on, only the single-tap target request (bit 0) is raised every frame, never bit 24, which r2 also raised. The reticle draw 0x61ecc0 is never called, since with the lock held it would run every frame.
runtime_test: r4 has not run (r3, without the reticle patches, was packaged and never run). The user ran the cheat itself and found it better than r2: "didnt ruin aiming"; without the reticle part "the reticle will have problem". r2 was accepted on Eden and MHGURecomp 0.14.3 (EVIDENCE.json).
